title: That picture frame is not sturdy
text: That picture frame is not sturdy. When adding pictures to the frame, the frame is not very sturdy to put the pictures in each slot. The pictures continue to fall out. Also, the little hooks that connect the frame together are very weak.

description: The Melannco 12-Opening Black Collage Photo Frame is an eye-catching way to display cherished memories of birthday parties, graduations, family vacations, and more. Made of plastic with a bold black finish and overlapping individual frames, this contemporary wall collage makes a great focal piece on a wall in your home or office. It features sawtooth hangers on the back for either vertical or horizontal hanging. Holds six 4 x 6 inch and six 6 x 4 inch photos. Measures 18 x 23 inches.
